name: devknobs
author: Mert Duzgun
description: drop-in dev panel for emulating browser preferences, locale, geolocation and layout knobs from inside the page

scripts.build: bun scripts/bezelurls.ts && bun -e 'require("fs").rmSync("dist.tmp",{recursive:true,force:true})' && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist.tmp --format esm --splitting && bun build src/react.tsx --outdir dist.tmp --format esm --splitting --external react --banner '"use client";' && bun build src/global.ts --outfile dist.tmp/index.global.js --format iife --minify --define 'import.meta.url=""' && bun build src/early.ts --outfile dist.tmp/early.global.js --format iife --minify && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.build.json --outDir dist.tmp && if [ -d assets/bezels ]; then cp -R assets/bezels dist.tmp/bezels; fi && bun -e 'const fs=require("fs");fs.rmSync("dist",{recursive:true,force:true});fs.renameSync("dist.tmp","dist")'
